title: Social media, l'Agcom avvia verifiche con la Commissione Ue sugli algoritmi di Meta. Focus sui contenuti politici
snippet: This news article reports on AGCOM (the Italian communications authority) launching formal audits and investigations into Meta's recommendation algorithms. This regulatory action was directly prompted by Professor Fabio Giglietto's study, which found that Meta's political content policies suppress moderate political voices to the advantage of extremist accounts.
